function.name: rop_uses_src
function.description: This function checks if the given DWORD parameter, when shifted right by 2 and bitwise ANDed with 0x330000, is not equal to the DWORD parameter bitwise ANDed with 0x330000.

parameters.name: rop
parameters.description: This parameter is used for bitwise operations to determine the return value.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the bitwise operation on the parameter 'rop' results in a non-equal comparison.

function.name: intersect_vis_rectangles
function.description: This function intersects two rectangles, possibly stretching one to fit the other. It adjusts the coordinates of the source and destination rectangles based on their dimensions and positions, and checks if they intersect. If they do not intersect, the function returns FALSE. If they do intersect, the function modifies the source and destination rectangles to be the intersection, and returns TRUE.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination rectangle. Its coordinates and dimensions may be modified by this function.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source rectangle. Its coordinates and dimensions may be modified by this function.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the source and destination rectangles intersect. Returns TRUE if they intersect, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: get_vis_rectangles
function.description: This function calculates the visible rectangles for the source and destination bitblt coordinates, and checks if they intersect.

parameters.name: dc_dst
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination device context

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination bitblt coordinates

parameters.name: dc_src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source device context

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitblt coordinates

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the source and destination visible rectangles intersect, FALSE otherwise

function.name: free_heap_bits
function.description: This function frees the memory allocated to the pointer in the gdi_image_bits structure.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to a gdi_image_bits structure. The function will free the memory allocated to the pointer within this structure.

function.return_type: void, which means this function does not return any value

function.name: convert_bits
function.description: This function converts the bits of a source bitmap into a destination bitmap, handling memory allocation and error checking.

parameters.name: src_info
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap information structure.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap coordinates structure.

parameters.name: dst_info
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination bitmap information structure.

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the structure containing the bits of the image.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the error code. If the function executes successfully, it returns the error code from convert_bitmapinfo function. If memory allocation fails, it returns ERROR_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: stretch_bits
function.description: This function stretches the bits of a source bitmap to fit the dimensions of a destination bitmap. It also handles memory allocation for the destination bitmap and error handling.

parameters.name: src_info
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap information

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Coordinates of the source bitmap

parameters.name: dst_info
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination bitmap information

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Coordinates of the destination bitmap

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the structure that holds the image bits

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Mode of operation

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the error code. If the function executes successfully, it returns the result of the stretch_bitmapinfo function. If memory allocation fails, it returns ERROR_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: blend_bits
function.description: This function blends two bitmaps using the specified blend function. It first checks if the destination bits are a copy, if not, it creates a copy of the destination bits. Then it calls the blend_bitmapinfo function to blend the source and destination bitmaps.

parameters.name: src_info
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bitmap information

parameters.name: src_bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the source image bits

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source bit block transfer coordinates

parameters.name: dst_info
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination bitmap information

parameters.name: dst_bits
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination image bits

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Pointer to the destination bit block transfer coordinates

parameters.name: blend
parameters.description: Blend function to be used for blending the source and destination bitmaps

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the status of the operation. It returns ERROR_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, otherwise it returns the result of the blend_bitmapinfo function

function.name: get_dc_rgb_color
function.description: This function retrieves the RGB color value from a given device context, color table size, and color reference. It handles different color formats including PALETTEINDEX and DIBINDEX.

parameters.name: dc
parameters.description: Pointer to the device context from which the color is retrieved

parameters.name: color_table_size
parameters.description: Size of the color table

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color reference value to be converted to RGB

function.return_type: RGBQUAD, represents the RGB color value retrieved from the given device context and color reference

function.name: get_mono_dc_colors
function.description: This function sets the colors for a monochrome device context (DC) using a color table and a bitmap information structure. It also sets the number of color indexes in the bitmap that are actually used by the DC.

parameters.name: dc
parameters.description: Pointer to the device context whose colors are to be set

parameters.name: color_table_size
parameters.description: Size of the color table

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a BITMAPINFO structure that contains information about the bitmap

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Number of color indexes in the bitmap that are actually used by the device context

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: nulldrv_StretchBlt
function.description: This function is used to stretch and/or translate the colors of a source bitmap into a destination bitmap.

parameters.name: dst_dev
parameters.description: This is the destination device.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination bitmap coordinates.

parameters.name: src_dev
parameters.description: This is the source device.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source bitmap coordinates.

parameters.name: rop
parameters.description: This is the raster-operation code. It defines how the color data for the source rectangle is to be combined with the color data for the destination rectangle to achieve the final color.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function is successful, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: nulldrv_AlphaBlend
function.description: This function blends two images using the specified blending function. It handles errors and performs necessary conversions and transformations.

parameters.name: dst_dev
parameters.description: Destination device context

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Coordinates for the destination image

parameters.name: src_dev
parameters.description: Source device context

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Coordinates for the source image

parameters.name: func
parameters.description: The blending function to be used

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the operation is successful, FALSE otherwise

function.name: nulldrv_BlendImage
function.description: This function blends an image using the provided blend function, source and destination coordinates, and image bits. It also handles errors and updates the format if necessary.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Device context to perform operations on

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Information about the image to blend

parameters.name: bits
parameters.description: Bits of the image to blend

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Source coordinates for the blend operation

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: Destination coordinates for the blend operation

parameters.name: blend
parameters.description: Blend function to use for the operation

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the status of the operation. It can return various error codes or ERROR_SUCCESS if the operation is successful

function.name: nulldrv_GradientFill
function.description: This function fills a region with a gradient color. The region can be a rectangle or a triangle. The function uses device context, vertices array, gradient array, and mode to perform the operation.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the device context.

parameters.name: vert_array
parameters.description: This is an array of vertices.

parameters.name: nvert
parameters.description: This is the number of vertices.

parameters.name: grad_array
parameters.description: This is the gradient array.

parameters.name: ngrad
parameters.description: This is the number of gradients.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: This is the mode of gradient fill. It can be either GRADIENT_FILL_TRIANGLE or GRADIENT_FILL_RECT.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the operation was successful or not. Returns TRUE if successful, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: nulldrv_GetPixel
function.description: This function retrieves the color of the pixel at the specified coordinates.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This is the physical device.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: This is the x-coordinate of the pixel.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: This is the y-coordinate of the pixel.

function.return_type: COLORREF, which represents the color of the pixel at the specified coordinates. If the pixel is outside the current clipping region, the return value is CLR_INVALID.

function.name: NtGdiPatBlt
function.description: This function performs a bit-block transfer of the color data corresponding to a rectangle of pixels from the specified source device context into a destination device context.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the destination device context.

parameters.name: left
parameters.description: Specifies the x-coordinate (in logical units) of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: top
parameters.description: Specifies the y-coordinate (in logical units) of the upper-left corner of the destination rectangle.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Specifies the width (in logical units) of the source and destination rectangles.

parameters.name: height
parameters.description: Specifies the height (in logical units) of the source and the destination rectangles.

parameters.name: rop
parameters.description: Specifies a raster-operation code. These codes define how the color data for the source rectangle is to be combined with the color data for the destination rectangle to achieve the final color.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was successful or not. If the function succeeds, the return value is TRUE. If the function fails, the return value is FALSE.
